summary: Configured node1 to lock local accounts after five failed password attempts for 300 seconds. The policy and enforcement remained healthy after a verified node reboot.
actions_performed: Added pam_faillock preauth, authfail, and account enforcement to system-auth and password-auth.
Functionally verified authentication succeeds after four failures but is denied after five.
Restarted node1 once and confirmed its boot identity changed.
Re-tested authentication and lockout enforcement after restart.
Removed all disposable test users, credentials, and artifacts.

evidence.summary: Both PAM stacks contain deny=5, unlock_time=300, and account enforcement; final file ownership, SELinux context, and policy assertions pass.

evidence.requirement: Enforce lockout after exactly five failed attempts
evidence.summary: Four failures allowed subsequent valid authentication; five failures created five tally records and caused correct-password authentication to fail.
Healthy baseline and boot ID were captured, one reboot was acknowledged, the boot ID changed, sshd and PAM recovered, and lockout enforcement was functionally reverified.
Disposable identities and secrets are absent; node1 is running with active sshd, reachable SSH, retained PAM policy, and zero failed units.
